bio: This charming and exceptionally well-run restaurant on Marktplatz has a trendy and chic feel. Led by the chef Martino Stirn, after which it is named, the kitchen team creates flavoursome Mediterranean-influenced dishes using seasonal ingredients. Order à la carte or take a punt on the surprise menu. Lunch options are more limited. The lady of the house provides charming service. Tables on the terrace are much in demand in summer....
